name: ZBP-US PII
expression: ((D:ZBP-Social Security Numbers (US) - High > 4) OR (D:ZBP-Social Security Numbers (US) - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:ZBP-Tax Identification Number (US) - High > 4) OR (D:ZBP-Tax Identification Number (US) - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:ZBP-Alien Registration Number - High Confidence > 4) OR (D:ZBP-Alien Registration Number - Prox 500 > 0) OR ((D:ZBP-Date of Birth - High Confidence > 1) AND (D:ZBP-Drivers License (United States) - High > 4)))

name: ZBP-Private Keys
expression: ((D:ZBP-Private Keys-Plaintext Regex > 0) OR (D:ZBP-JWK Private Key > 0) OR (D:ZBP-Private Key > 0) OR (D:ZBP-Encrypted or ASCII Armored PGP Keys > 0) OR (D:ZBP-Encrypted Bouncy Castle Key Exports > 0))

name: ZBP-Financial Information
expression: ((D:ZBP-ABA Bank Routing Number - High > 4) OR (D:ZBP-ABA Bank Routing Number - Prox 500 > 1) OR (D:ZBP-Credit Cards - High > 4) OR (D:ZBP-Credit Cards - Prox 500 > 1) OR (D:ZBP-Credit Card Magnetic Tracks > 0) OR (D${data.zia_dlp_dictionaries.predefined_ml_tax_leakage.id}.S > 0) OR (D:ZBP-Form K-1 > 3) OR (D:ZBP-Form 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC > 4) OR (D:ZBP-W2 or W4 or W9 Forms > 3) OR (D:ZBP-Form 1040 and related schedules > 3) OR (D${data.zia_dlp_dictionaries.predefined_financial.id}.S > 0) OR (D${data.zia_dlp_dictionaries.predefined_ml_corporate_finance_leakage.id}.S > 0))

name: ZBP-US PHI - Medium Confidence
expression: (((D${data.zia_dlp_dictionaries.predefined_ml_medical_doc_leakage.id}.S > 0) OR ((D${data.zia_dlp_dictionaries.predefined_medical.id}.S > 0) AND ((D${data.zia_dlp_dictionaries.predefined_drugs_leakage.id}.S > 9) OR (D${data.zia_dlp_dictionaries.predefined_diseases_leakage.id}.S > 9)))) AND ((D:ZBP-Social Security Numbers (US) - High > 0) OR (D:ZBP-US Passport - High Confidence > 0) OR (D:ZBP-Alien Registration Number - High Confidence > 0) OR ((D:ZBP-Date of Birth - High Confidence > 0) AND (D:ZBP-Drivers License (United States) - Prox 500 > 0))))

name: ZBP-US PHI - High Confidence
expression: (((D${data.zia_dlp_dictionaries.predefined_ml_medical_doc_leakage.id}.S > 0) OR ((D${data.zia_dlp_dictionaries.predefined_medical.id}.S > 0) AND ((D${data.zia_dlp_dictionaries.predefined_drugs_leakage.id}.S > 14) OR (D${data.zia_dlp_dictionaries.predefined_diseases_leakage.id}.S > 14)))) AND ((D:ZBP-Social Security Numbers (US) - High > 4) OR (D:ZBP-US Passport - High Confidence > 4) OR (D:ZBP-Alien Registration Number - High Confidence > 4) OR ((D:ZBP-Date of Birth - Prox 500 > 1) AND (D:ZBP-Drivers License (United States) - Prox 500 > 1)) OR (D:ZBP-Social Security Numbers (US) - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:ZBP-US Passport - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:ZBP-Alien Registration Number - Prox 500 > 0)))
